description: This file defines classes and methods for managing vector store registries, including in-memory and database-backed storage, retrieval, loading from configuration, and handling vector store operations within a larger system.

classes.name: VectorStoreIndexRegistry
classes.description: Manages a registry of vector store indexes, including CRUD operations and database synchronization.

classes.name: VectorStoreRegistry
classes.description: Manages a collection of vector stores, including loading from config, retrieval, addition, deletion, and database fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: get_vector_store_indexes
methods.description: Returns the list of vector store indexes.

methods.name: get_vector_store_index_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a vector store index by its name.

methods.name: upsert_vector_store_index
methods.description: Adds or updates a vector store index in the registry.

methods.name: delete_vector_store_index
methods.description: Deletes a vector store index by its name.

methods.name: is_vector_store_index
methods.description: Checks if a vector store index exists in the registry.

methods.name: _get_vector_store_indexes_from_db
methods.description: Fetches vector store indexes from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: get_vector_store_ids_to_run
methods.description: Determines which vector store IDs should be used for a run based on parameters and tools.

methods.name: get_and_pop_recognised_vector_store_tools
methods.description: Extracts and removes recognized vector store tools from a list.

methods.name: get_vector_store_to_run
methods.description: Returns the first vector store to run based on provided parameters and tools.

methods.name: get_litellm_managed_vector_store_from_registry
methods.description: Retrieves a vector store from the in-memory registry by ID.

methods.name: get_litellm_managed_vector_store_from_registry_or_db
methods.description: Retrieves a vector store from registry or database, with fallback and synchronization.

methods.name: get_litellm_managed_vector_store_from_registry_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a vector store from registry by name.

methods.name: pop_vector_stores_to_run
methods.description: Removes vector store IDs from parameters and returns vector stores with merged tool parameters.

methods.name: pop_vector_stores_to_run_with_db_fallback
methods.description: Removes vector store IDs, with database fallback, and returns vector stores with merged parameters.

methods.name: _get_vector_store_ids_from_tool_calls
methods.description: Extracts vector store IDs from tool call dictionaries.

methods.name: load_vector_stores_from_config
methods.description: Loads vector stores from configuration data.

methods.name: list_all_vector_stores
methods.description: Returns a list response of all vector stores.

methods.name: add_vector_store_to_registry
methods.description: Adds a vector store to the in-memory registry if not already present.

methods.name: delete_vector_store_from_registry
methods.description: Removes a vector store from the registry by ID.

methods.name: update_vector_store_in_registry
methods.description: Updates or adds a vector store in the registry.

methods.name: _get_vector_stores_from_db
methods.description: Fetches vector stores from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: get_credentials_for_vector_store
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a specific vector store.
